claims.claim: Costco Wholesale operates a membership‑based warehouse club and e‑commerce platform that focuses on low‑price, limited‑assortment merchandise to drive high sales volumes and rapid inventory turnover.
claims.quote: We operate membership warehouses and e‑commerce sites based on the concept that offering low prices on a limited selection of nationally‑branded and private‑label products in a wide range of categories will produce high sales volumes and rapid inventory turnover.

claims.claim: The business model relies on volume purchasing, efficient distribution, and a no‑frills, self‑service warehouse format that enables profit at lower gross margins than most retailers.
claims.quote: When combined with the operating efficiencies achieved by volume purchasing, efficient distribution and reduced handling of merchandise in no‑frills, self‑service warehouse facilities, these volumes and turnover enable us to operate profitably at significantly lower gross margins (net sales less merchandise costs) than most other retailers.

claims.claim: Costco limits the number of active SKUs per warehouse to under 4,000, far fewer than typical broad‑line retailers, and carries 9,000‑11,000 SKUs online.
claims.quote: We carry less than 4,000 active stock keeping units (SKUs) per warehouse in our core warehouse business, significantly less than other broadline retailers. We average from 9,000 to 11,000 SKUs online, some of which are available in our warehouses.

claims.claim: Membership fees, renewal rates, and the growth of the Executive membership tier are key profitability drivers.
claims.quote: Membership fee revenue increased 11% to $5,907, driven by new member sign‑ups, membership fee increases, and upgrades to Executive membership.

claims.claim: In 2026, Costco operated 939 warehouses worldwide, with 647 in the United States, 115 in Canada, and the remainder in other international markets.
claims.quote: At August 30, 2026, Costco operated 939 warehouses worldwide: 647 in the United States (U.S.) located in 47 states, Washington, D.C., and Puerto Rico, 115 in Canada, 43 in Mexico, 37 in Japan, 29 in the U.K., 20 in Korea, 15 in Australia, 14 in Taiwan, seven in China, five in Spain, three in France, two in Sweden, and one each in Iceland and New Zealand.

claims.claim: The company’s “Other Businesses” segment—e‑commerce, business centers, travel, and gas stations—contributed 11% of total net sales in 2026.
claims.quote: Our other businesses sell products and services that largely complement our warehouse operations... Digitally‑enabled sales, which represents sales that are initiated through a digital device... as well as Costco Travel, represented 11% of total net sales in 2026.

claims.claim: Gasoline sales represented 11% of total net sales in 2026, derived from 774 gas stations operating alongside warehouses.
claims.quote: We operated 774 gas stations at the end of 2026. Our gasoline business represented 11% of total net sales in 2026.

claims.claim: The private‑label Kirkland Signature brand is positioned as high‑quality, lower‑priced than national brands and is expected to increase its sales penetration.
claims.quote: We believe that Kirkland Signature products are high quality, offered at prices that are generally lower than national brands, and help lower costs, differentiate our merchandise offerings, and generally earn higher margins. We expect to continue to increase the sales penetration of our private‑label items.

claims.claim: Costco views its warehouses as among the most productive in the retail industry, citing high employee retention and a target of at least 50% full‑time staff.
claims.quote: We believe that our warehouses are among the most productive in the retail industry... a target ratio of at least 50% of our base being full‑time employees.

claims.claim: The firm competes globally with a wide range of retailers, including Walmart, Target, Kroger, Amazon, and other warehouse clubs such as Sam’s Club and BJ’s.
claims.quote: Walmart, Target, Kroger, and Amazon are among our significant general merchandise retail competitors in the U.S. We also compete with other warehouse clubs, including Walmart’s Sam’s Club and BJ’s Wholesale Club in the U.S.

claims.claim: Costco’s competitive advantage is rooted in low prices, limited assortment, rapid turnover, and the ability to sell inventory before payment is due, often capturing early‑payment discounts.
claims.quote: We often sell inventory before we are required to pay for it, even while taking advantage of early payment discounts.

claims.claim: The company’s growth strategy emphasizes opening new warehouses (both domestic and international) and expanding e‑commerce capabilities.
claims.quote: We also achieve net sales growth by opening new warehouses. As our warehouse base grows and available and desirable sites become more difficult to secure, square footage growth becomes a comparatively less substantial component of growth.

claims.claim: International warehouse expansion is a priority; 31% of the total warehouse count (292 locations) is outside the U.S., and the company expects continued international growth.
claims.quote: At the end of 2026, we operated 292 warehouses outside of the U.S. (31% of all warehouse locations), and we plan to continue expanding our international operations.

claims.claim: Specific growth catalysts cited by management include digitally‑enabled comparable sales growth (≈20% YoY) and membership fee revenue growth (≈11% YoY).
claims.quote: Digitally‑Enabled ... 20.9% ... for the fiscal year 2026 (excluding the impacts from changes in gasoline prices and foreign exchange).

claims.claim: Net sales for FY 2026 grew 10.1% to $297.2 billion, driven largely by comparable sales growth across all regions.
claims.quote: Net sales for the fiscal year increased 10.1 percent, to $297.2 billion, from $269.9 billion last year.

claims.claim: Comparable sales for the full year rose 6.6% company‑wide, with the U.S. contributing 8.2% growth.
claims.quote: Total Company ... 6.6% (adjusted) for 52 Weeks.

claims.claim: Membership renewal rates at year‑end 2026 were 92.3% in the U.S. and Canada and 89.8% worldwide.
claims.quote: At the end of 2026, member renewal rates were 92.3% in the U.S. and Canada and 89.8% worldwide.

claims.claim: The company raised annual membership fees in the U.S. and Canada effective September 1, 2024, which contributed roughly 30‑40% of membership‑fee revenue growth in 2025‑2026.
claims.quote: We increased annual membership fees in the U.S. and Canada, effective September 1, 2024... The fee income increase accounted for approximately 30% and 40% of membership income growth during 2026 and 2025.

claims.claim: The IEEPA tariff refund received in Q4 2026 added a non‑recurring $0.15 per diluted share benefit to net income.
claims.quote: This year's fourth quarter was positively impacted by a non‑recurring benefit of $0.15 per diluted share from IEEPA tariff refunds received in the quarter.

claims.claim: Costco’s gasoline business tends to boost traffic to warehouses; rising gasoline prices raise net sales but lower gross‑margin percentages, while lower gasoline prices have the opposite effect.
claims.quote: We believe our gasoline business enhances traffic in our warehouses; it generally has a lower gross margin percentage... Rising gasoline prices benefit net sales growth which, given the higher sales base, negatively impacts our gross margin percentage but decreases our SG&A expenses as a percentage of net sales.

claims.claim: Digital and e‑commerce investments are considered crucial for retaining members; the company notes that failure to keep pace could hurt results.
claims.quote: We must keep pace with changing member expectations and new developments by our competitors. Our members are increasingly using mobile phones, tablets, computers, and other devices to shop... If we are unable to make, improve, or develop relevant member‑facing technology in a timely manner, our ability to compete and our results of operations could be adversely affected.

claims.claim: Costco is actively managing cybersecurity risk, employing NIST and CIS frameworks, third‑party assessments, and a security operations center.
claims.quote: We have implemented processes, technologies, and controls to seek to assess, identify, and manage risks associated with cybersecurity threats. Management considers cybersecurity risks within our overall approach to enterprise risk management.

claims.claim: The firm acknowledges AI‑related competitive risk: competitors with faster AI adoption could erode its pricing and member‑loyalty advantages.
claims.quote: Some competitors have greater technology capabilities, including the faster adoption of AI technologies... Our inability to respond effectively to competitive pressures, changes in the retail markets or customer expectations could result in lost market share.

claims.claim: Management expects continued expansion of warehouse square footage in international markets where the base is smaller, potentially offsetting slower U.S. growth.
claims.quote: Our operating models are generally the same across our U.S., Canadian, and Other International operating segments... Certain operations in the Other International segment have relatively higher rates of square footage growth.

claims.claim: Costco plans to maintain its high employee‑retention focus, targeting a 50% full‑time workforce and emphasizing internal promotion, which it believes supports operational productivity.
claims.quote: We seek to provide them not merely with employment but careers... a target ratio of at least 50% of our base being full‑time employees.

claims.claim: The company’s cash position ($20.2 billion) and operating cash flow ($15.8 billion) are expected to be sufficient to meet liquidity and capital needs for the foreseeable future.
claims.quote: We believe that our cash and investment positions and operating cash flow... will be sufficient to meet our liquidity and capital requirements for the foreseeable future.

claims.claim: Share repurchases continue under a $4 billion program that expires January 2027; 891,000 shares were repurchased in 2026 at an average price of $950.90.
claims.quote: During 2026 ... we repurchased 891,000 ... shares of common stock, at an average price per share of $950.90, totaling $847.

claims.claim: The company expects growth of its digitally‑enabled sales (online and Costco Travel) to remain a significant driver, representing 11% of total net sales in 2026.
claims.quote: ... Digitally‑enabled sales, which represents sales that are initiated through a digital device... represented 11% of total net sales in 2026.
